excerpt: Founded in 1962 ... administrated by Stanford University ... sponsored by the United States Department of Energy. 2575 Sand Hill Rd. Menlo Park, California 94025, coordinates 37 25'03''N 122 12'09''W. 3.2 km (2 mi) long accelerator that could accelerate electrons to energies of 20 GeV, and later up to 50 GeV. PEP-II operated From 1999 to 2008 as an electron-positron collider with a pair of storage rings 2.2 km (1.4 mi) in circumference. The center of mass energy [of SLC] was about 90 GeV.
